settings.title: Day Info Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure school vacation zone and public holiday region
settings.dataHelp: Public holidays and school vacations come from official APIs (calendrier.api.gouv.fr, data.education.gouv.fr) and are cached on your Homey. Moon, season and weekend are computed locally.
settings.autoUpdateHelp: Every night (around 00:05 Paris time), the app recalculates day info and triggers your Flows when something changes. Remote cache is renewed automatically at most every 90 days (vacations) or 180 days (public holidays).
settings.syncHelp: "Force sync" re-downloads remote calendars immediately, even if the cache is still valid — useful after changing zone or region.
settings.schoolZoneHelp: The zone depends on the school academy, not necessarily your home address. Geolocation suggestion is only a hint.
settings.suggestError: Could not determine zone from location
